name: scraping-zap
description: Scraper de zapatillas por talla para tiendas VTEX de Bolivia, con historial de precios y comparacion entre tiendas

scripts.scrape: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js scrape
scripts.serve: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js serve
scripts.report: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js report
scripts.compare: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js compare
scripts.runs: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js runs
